'''George Arthur Elliott''' {{post-nominals|country=CAN|FRSC}} (born 1945) is a Canadian mathematician specializing in [[operator algebras]], [[K-theory]], and [[non-commutative geometry]]. He is a [[Canada Research Chair]] at the [[University of Toronto Department of Mathematics|University of Toronto]].<ref>{{cite web |title=George Elliott |url=https://www.mathematics.utoronto.ca/people/directories/all-faculty/george-elliott|website=[[University of Toronto Department of Mathematics]]|access-date=23 August 2026}}</ref> He is best known for his work on [[C*-algebra]]s, both for initiating their classification<ref>{{cite book |title=An introduction to C*-algebras and the classification programme|last=Strung |first=Karen R. |page=7 |url=https://strung.me/karen/CStarIntroDraft.pdf}}</ref> and highlighting the importance of K-theory in this respect.<ref>{{Cite book|title=Introduction to K-Theory for C-Algebras|last1=Rørdam|first1=Mikael|publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]]|year=200|isbn=9780521789448|pages=ix|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=SMiB8VIB5UIC|last2=Larsen|first2=Flemming|last3=Laustsen}}</ref>

He was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Zürich]], 1994.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897 |access-date=2011-12-05 |archive-date=2017-11-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1994.2/Main/icm1994.2.0922.0932.ocr.pdf |title=George A. Elliott. The classification problem for amenable C*-algebras |access-date=2012-01-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150423055439/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1994.2/Main/icm1994.2.0922.0932.ocr.pdf |archive-date=2015-04-23 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Awards and honours==

* 1982 Elected as Fellow of [[Royal Society of Canada]].<ref>[[:fr:Liste des membres de la Société royale du Canada (1946-1985)]]</ref>
* 1996 CRM/Fields Institute Prize<ref>[https://www.fields.utoronto.ca/honours/crm-fields-pims_prize.html CRM/Fields Institute Prize]</ref>
* 1996-1998 Killam Research Fellow.<ref>[https://canadacouncil.ca/-/media/Files/CCA/Funding/Prizes/Laureates/Killam-Research-Fellowships-Cumulative-List-2020.pdf List of Killam Research Fellows]</ref>
* 1998 [[Jeffery–Williams Prize]].<ref>[[Jeffery–Williams Prize]]</ref>
* 1999 [[John L. Synge Award]].<ref>[http://www.rsc.ca/awards_John_L_Synge_Award_winner.php John L. Synge Award] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120313070218/http://www.rsc.ca/awards_John_L_Synge_Award_winner.php |date=March 13, 2012 }}</ref>
* 2012 Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2012-12-02.</ref>
* 2019 Fellow of the [[Canadian Mathematical Society]]<ref>{{citation|url=https://cms.math.ca/MediaReleases/2019/Fellows|title=Canadian Mathematical Society's Second Inaugural Class of Fellows Announced|publisher=[[Canadian Mathematical Society]]|access-date=2020-01-06|archive-date=2019-08-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190802123530/https://cms.math.ca/MediaReleases/2019/Fellows|url-status=dead}}</ref>
